stories.title: President Paudel issues two more ordinances on forest and land laws
stories.summary: Kathmandu, October 13 President Ram Chandra Paudel has issued two more ordinances, amending various laws related to forests and land. President Paudel issued the Forest-Related Some Nepal Acts Amendment Ordinance, 2026, and the Land-Related Some Nepal Acts Amendment Ordinance, 2026, on Tuesday afternoon, according to Shyam Prasad Bhandari, spokesperson for the President’s Office. stories.summary: पूर्वाधार विकासका नाममा हरेक वर्ष हजारौं रूख काटिन्छन्। काटिएका रूखको सट्टा वन विकास गर्ने उद्देश्यले स्थापना गरिएको कोषमा अर्थ मन्त्रालयबाटै आठ अर्ब ५४ करोड रुपैयाँभन्दा बढी रकम आउन बाँकी छ। कोषमा रकम नआउँदा वन संरक्षण, वृक्षरोपणदेखि जैविक विविधता जोगाउने कामसम्म प्रभावित हुँदैछ।
